title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.309 - Fixed host-supplied `managedSettings` dropping `disableAllHooks`, `disableSkillShellExecution` and empty `allowedHttpHookUrls` / `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` lists - Changed `extractFromBunfs()` to extract the embedded CLI into its own per-user temp directory (`claude-agent-sdk-<uid>`, or `claude-agent-sdk` on Windows) instead of Claude Code's temp root - Changed `extractFromBunfs()` to reuse an already-extracted file only when its bytes match the embedded binary, replacing it otherwise - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.309 ## 0.3.308 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.308 ## 0.3.307 - Added `wakeup_source` to the `command_lifecycle` `started` frame of a scheduled wakeup or task, and `scheduled_for` for a wakeup (capability `lifecycle_wakeup_source_v1`), so a host can tell which one fired
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
